text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: "...Huh? What... does this mean?"

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
I understand there was an earthquake, but 
is the scale of damage... really this 
severe?

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Unprecedented in scale... The damage north 
of the Kanto region is especially 
catastrophic...

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: No way...

"The expedition team was so far away that 
it didn't really feel real at all, but..."

――Magnitude 9.0 class. A megaquake has 
struck Japan.

The epicenter was far from Tracen Academy. 
While the full extent of the impact was 
still unknown...

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: —Can you hear me, Ruler?

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
Air Groove-san is busy with student 
council duties, so I'll do it.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
The epicenter was in the north, but the 
disaster's impact—is nationwide.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: On a nationwide scale...

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
Yes, let alone the races, even daily 
infrastructure has been severely impacted.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
It's a complete state of emergency. 
Everyone is desperate just trying to 
assess the situation and keep their 
composure.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: Ruler-san, I don't lie. That's why...

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
I can't say that everything is fine. But 
if there's one thing I can tell you right 
now—

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: —Don't come back. Not for a while.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
"There's no reason for you to get dragged 
into this too. See you."

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: Groove...

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
What on earth............ is 
this............

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Everyone at the school and Tracen 
Academy... is safe. I understand that. 
But...

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: Everything else was...

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: What is this... even supposed to be...?

There was nothing I could say. I wanted to 
encourage her... but the situation was 
simply too unclear.

Even so, race day was drawing closer and 
closer by the second.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: So this is... the rivals' stat sheet...

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
This is the track's cushion value, and 
here's the projected pace...

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Every single piece is a gem of data. And 
yet...

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, nothing's getting into my head... 
Nothing at all...

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
In the first place, what are we even doing 
this for...?

Rulership wasn't the only one losing 
composure.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: U-Uuuu...

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Ugh, no good... Even if I try to gather 
info, everything's just too chaotic...

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: Gh, taking another route!

Racing was the furthest thing from 
everyone's mind. Even so, time continued 
to pass.

"Perhaps I should return home. If I can no 
longer find any meaning in this."

Steeling my resolve, I walk up to 
Rulership.
choice_data_list:
Ruler, if it looks like it's too much for 
you...

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: ...It's a game.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
This is... a game. I can't bring reality 
into it.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
The important thing is... not shouldering 
it all, letting things go... and having 
fun.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Anyone who falls behind on that gets 
eliminated. That's right... Even if I go 
home now, there's nothing I can do anyway.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
"I will win. ...I'm going to win. I'll see 
this game through to the very end."

If I cry and scream, it's over. Right 
now... I'm not even allowed to do that.

—Before the race. Naturally, the 
disastrous situation in Japan had reached 
foreign shores as well.

A slightly distinct emotion mixes into the 
cheers. The atmosphere is clearly 
different from previous years, but...

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: It has... nothing to do with me.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
It doesn't matter... In the first place, 
I'm not the type who has room to worry 
about others.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
"I have to... see myself through to the 
end. Play out my own game..."

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
I will become it—even if no one wishes for 
it, I will become the ruler... of this 
board!
